questions.response: National Pension System (NPS): Government-backed retirement savings. You contribute, build corpus, get monthly pension after retirement. Required: Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Employment details, Income, Desired pension, Current/retirement age, Existing pension, Address, Pincode, PRAN if registered, Contribution, Investment pattern, Asset allocation. Apply via Services > Pension.

Atal Pension Yojana (APY): Government scheme for unorganized workers. Guarantees fixed monthly pension after 60. Required: Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Desired pension (₹1000-5000), Current/retirement age, Existing pension, Address, Pincode, Savings bank account, IFSC, Nominee details. Simple, low-cost, secure.

PM-SYM (Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan): For workers earning ₹15,000/month or less. Government contributes 50% pension contributions. Required: Personal info, Employment details, Income, Desired pension, Age, Existing pension, Address, Pincode, Average monthly income, CSC ID if any, Spouse details (joint benefit), Nominee. Apply via Services > Pension > PM-SYM.

Senior Citizen Pension: For retirees 60+. Guarantees fixed monthly income. Required: Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Desired pension, Current age, Retirement age, Existing pension, Address, Pincode, Age proof, Bank account, IFSC, Other pension info, Nominee. Ensures post-retirement security.

Pension = Lifetime guaranteed income (even if funds run out), long-term, lower risk. Savings = Own funds, higher flexibility, higher returns possible, ends when funds finish. Pension ideal for security; savings for growth.

Contribution varies: NPS flexible (₹500-min to ₹2.5 lakh/year), APY ₹55-291/month (age 18-40), PM-SYM ₹55-291/month, Senior Citizen depends on desired pension. Use calculators to determine optimal contribution.

Government matches: APY 50% contribution (for enrolled workers), PM-SYM 50% contribution (for eligible workers), Senior Citizen Pension some subsidies available. Check eligibility for schemes offering government co-contribution.
Typically at 60 (NPS), 60 (APY), 60 (PM-SYM), or immediately (Senior Citizen). Can take partial withdrawal after 7 years (NPS). Get monthly pension or lump sum options depending on scheme.
Calculated by: (Total corpus × Annuity rate) ÷ 12 months. Higher contributions and longer tenure = higher pension. Use Pension Calculator (Services section) for exact estimate based on your details.
NPS allows switching between investment options. Can change asset allocation (equity, debt, government securities) based on risk profile. Limited switches/year; some charges may apply.
Age varies: NPS (18-60), APY (18-40), PM-SYM (18-50), Senior Citizen Pension (60+). Employment type varies. All require Indian residency and valid ID. Check specific scheme eligibility.
NPS contribution qualifies for tax deduction under 80C (up to ₹1.5 lakh), plus additional ₹50,000 under 80CCD(1B). Tax-efficient retirement planning. Additional tax benefits on pension received.
